ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens: mostly large dark-green spinach-like leaves and ruffled light-green lettuce pieces with pale yellow-green frilly edges, spread across the upper and central plate; matte, slightly moist, soft and pliable, leaves about 5-10 cm long | 95
ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-purple to maroon leaves (red leaf lettuce type), curled and slightly glossy, scattered among the greens on the lower and right side; pieces about 3-6 cm | 25
ITEM 3 | Sliced avocado: pale green flesh with darker green skin edge, two to three crescent-shaped slices about 6-8 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, smooth, slightly glossy, lying on the right side of the greens | 35
ITEM 4 | Small brownish-tan pieces, possibly rounded chunks about 1-2 cm, partly hidden among the leaves in the upper center; matte, slightly firm, no visible char or browning beyond natural tone | 15
ITEM 5 | Thin pale yellow-green shredded or frilly strands, a few small clusters on the upper center among the leaves; delicate, slightly wispy | 5
